name: ODRL Party
abstract: W3C ODRL 2.2 Party (a person, organization or agent identified by IRI) or PartyCollection (a group of parties, identified by @id, or by odrl:source narrowed with odrl:refinement). Used for the assigner and assignee of ODRL rules and policies. Uses building blocks: odrlConstraint (odrlProperties), objectReference (cdifDataType).
